# CS-005: The proxy access log is acquired

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

CrowdSec only sees what its acquisition reads. On a web host the proxy access log is where scans and brute force show up; without it the HTTP scenarios never fire. The log format (JSON for Traefik) has to match the parser and is not checked here.

## Verify by hand

```sh
cat /etc/crowdsec/acquis.yaml /etc/crowdsec/acquis.d/*.yaml; sudo cscli metrics
```

## How to fix it

Enable the proxy access log (JSON for Traefik) and add an acquisition entry with labels type set to the proxy (traefik, caddy, nginx)

## What a fix can break

Nothing; the engine reads more logs and uses a little more CPU.

Run `stackward explain CS-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
